title: Wildheart revision: intake the revised design system and close its gaps (tokens, photos, general feminine copy)

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 17:19Z uploaded the revised Wildheart Design System zip; 17:23Z took every recommended option (Wildheart is a general feminine website, no program copy)

detail: Intake ran per docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md: snapshot, rules, tokens and copy in docs/design-systems/wildheart/, and the design-system test now compares WILDHEART_TOKENS_CSS (light block) against the zip. Baseline froze 195 known gaps: about 80 tokens (violet moves to #6E4D96, muted text to #7D6D62, new gradients, about 50 semantic names not declared), 5 new photo exports, and 110 copy lines. Copy is NOT ported verbatim: the theme is a general website for any women-led Space, so its starter copy is written fresh per the voice guide and the program lines are retired from the baseline as rewritten. Follow-ups in order: retoken plus photos, then pages plus copy. The row closes when the baseline is empty. CLOSED 2026-11-03: violet family #6E4D96 / #5A3D7E / #654590 / #7D5BA8 (owner moved LIVE-1363's pin), opal, star, bloom, logo-ground and wordmark tokens added, the five photos re-exported, the semantic names mapped. Kept on purpose and named in tokenDeviations: muted #6B5B51 and the madder light stop (AA), the flat pressed violet and the token-built vellum and dusk gradients (v3 rules), the type scale (per element). The program's website copy is a reference rule: the kits already ship general copy. Baseline empty.
